Message.Name: Login Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to log in to the replay or recovery channel.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: CompID assigned to the client.

Message.Name: Recovery Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to request data on the recovery channel.

Field.Name: Request Level
Field.Description: Defines the level of the request.

Field.Name: Instrument
Field.Description: GTP Instrument identifier if Request Level is 0. Blank if not.

Field.Name: Group ID
Field.Description: Group/Segment ID if Request Level is 1. Blank if not.

Field.Name: Request Order Book Type
Field.Description: Only considered if the Request Level is 0. If specified, only data related to the specified order book type is provided. If not specified, data for all available book types for the instrument are provided. For Recovery Type = 3 (Statistics) this has to be set to '0' = All.

Field.Name: Source Venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Recovery Type
Field.Description: The type of messages to be replayed.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Only valid if Recovery Type = 2 (Trades). If specified, the trades reported with an equal or higher sequence number will be sent.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: The value set in this will be echoed back in the corresponding Recovery Response and Recovery Complete. The system will not validate uniqueness of the set value.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to accept or reject a login request to the replay or recovery channel.

Field.Name: Login Status
Field.Description: Status of the login request.

Message.Name: Recovery Response Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to respond to a snapshot request on the recovery channel.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number on the real-time channel with which the snapshot is synchronised when Recovery Type = 1, 2, 3, 4. This will be zero for other Recovery Types or if Status is not 'A'.

Field.Name: Count
Field.Description: Number of messages to follow, not including any Replay and Recovery Complete messages. This will be zero if Status is not 'A'.

Field.Name: Recovery Status
Field.Description: Status of the recovery request.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Will include the value set as Request ID in the Recovery Request message.

Message.Name: Replay and Recovery Complete Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to indicate the successful completion of servicing a message replay or a recovery request.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Will include the value set as Request ID in the Recovery Request message.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Current Trading status of the Instrument. Populated only when the message is sent at the end of individual order book snapshots during a trading session. Blank if not applicable.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Broadcast at the start and end of day on TRADEcho. Session transition is advertised via one system event message for all instruments allocated to the same multicast channel

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Event Code

Message.Name: Mifid II Trade Report Message
Message.Description: Sent to report the MiFID compliant details of a privately negotiated trade

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Instrument
Field.Description: GTP Instrument Identifier. This field will be populated with 0 for Non-Exchange listed instruments.

Field.Name: Transaction identification code
Field.Description: A unique trade identifier. The value will be right aligned.

Field.Name: Total Number of Transactions
Field.Description: Total Number of Transactions of aggregated trade.

Field.Name: Reserved Field
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Source Venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The trade price, limited to a precision of {DECIMAL-19/18}. Will be set to default value (20 spaces) if there is a pending price (PNDG). In case of transactions under ESMA jurisdiction, will be set to default value (20 spaces) if price is not available (NOAP).

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The number of units of the financial instrument or the number of derivative contracts in the trade, limited to a precision of {DECIMAL-19/18}. Will be set to default value (20 spaces) if quantity is not available. In case of transactions under FCA jurisdiction, will be set to default value (20 spaces) if the traded security is a bond.

Field.Name: Trading Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was executed or agreed upon. If a trade is cancelled or amended, this field will contain the trading date and time of the original trade. Blank for aggregated publications: DATF, FWAF, IDAF, COAF, AGFW.

Field.Name: Instrument Identification Code Type
Field.Description: Type of the instrument identification code.

Field.Name: Instrument Identification Code
Field.Description: Instrument identification number (UPI or ISIN code).

Field.Name: Price Notation
Field.Description: Indicates if the price is expressed in monetary value, in percentage or yield. Will be set to default value (4 spaces) if not available.

Field.Name: Price Major Currency / Price Currency
Field.Description: Major currency in which the price is expressed (applicable if the price is expressed as monetary value). Currency Code as per ISO 4217. Price Major Currency (FCA 2017/587) / Price Currency (ESMA, FCA 2017/583).

Field.Name: Notional Amount
Field.Description: Notional value relevant to the security, limited to a precision of {DECIMAL-19/18}.

Field.Name: Notional Currency
Field.Description: Major currency in which the notional amount is denominated.

Field.Name: Venue of Execution
Field.Description: Identification of the venue where the transaction was executed. XOFF = OTC, SINT = Systematic Internaliser, or the MIC corresponding to the relevant RM/MTF/OTF.

Field.Name: Publication Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was published.

Field.Name: Benchmark Transaction Flag
Field.Description: BENC when the trade is a benchmark trade.

Field.Name: Agency Cross Trade Flag
Field.Description: ACTX when the trade is an agency cross trade.

Field.Name: Non Price Forming Transactions Flag
Field.Description: NPFT when the trade is a non-price forming trade.

Field.Name: Non Price Contribution to Discovery
Field.Description: TNCP when the trade does not contribute to the price discovery process.

Field.Name: Special Dividend Flag
Field.Description: SDIV when the trade is a special dividend trade.

Field.Name: PT Deferral Reason Flag
Field.Description: Post trade deferral reason, SIZE or LRGS.

Field.Name: Reference Price Transaction Flag
Field.Description: RFPT when the trade is a reference price trade.

Field.Name: NT Liquidity Flag
Field.Description: Negotiated trade liquidity indication, NLIQ or OILQ.

Field.Name: NT Price Conditions Flag
Field.Description: PRIC when the negotiated trade is subject to conditions other than the current market price.

Field.Name: Algo Transaction Flag
Field.Description: ALGO when the trade is an algorithmic trade.

Field.Name: PT Illiquid Flag
Field.Description: ILQD when publication is deferred for an illiquid instrument.

Field.Name: Price Improvement Flag
Field.Description: RPRI when the trade has received price improvement.

Field.Name: Cancellation Flag
Field.Description: CANC when the trade is a cancellation.

Field.Name: Amendment Flag
Field.Description: AMND when the trade is an amendment.

Field.Name: Duplicate Flag
Field.Description: DUPL when the trade report is duplicative.

Field.Name: Exchange For Physicals Flag
Field.Description: Package or exchange for physicals trade, TPAC or XFPH.

Field.Name: Limited Details Flag
Field.Description: LMTF when the trade is a limited details trade.

Field.Name: LD Full Details Flag
Field.Description: FULF for full details of an earlier limited details trade.

Field.Name: Daily Aggregated Transaction Flag
Field.Description: DATF when the trade is a daily aggregated trade.

Field.Name: DA Full Details Flag
Field.Description: FULA for full details of an earlier daily aggregated trade.

Field.Name: Volume Omission Flag
Field.Description: VOLO when the trade is a volume omission trade.

Field.Name: VO Full Details Flag
Field.Description: FULV for full details of an earlier volume omission trade.

Field.Name: Four Weeks Aggregation Flag
Field.Description: FWAF when the trade is a four weeks aggregation trade.

Field.Name: FA Full Details Flag
Field.Description: FULJ for full details of an earlier four weeks aggregation trade.

Field.Name: Indefinite Aggregation Flag
Field.Description: IDAF when the trade is an indefinite aggregation trade.

Field.Name: Volume Omission For Sovereign Debt Flag
Field.Description: VOLW for a volume omission trade eligible for subsequent enrichment in aggregated form.

Field.Name: Consecutive Aggregation Flag
Field.Description: COAF for full details in aggregated form of an earlier volume omission trade.

Field.Name: Reserved Field
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Venue Type
Field.Description: Type sent by the venue.

Field.Name: Venue Book Definition ID
Field.Description: Book Definition ID sent by the venue.

Field.Name: Notation of the Quantity in Measurement Unit
Field.Description: Indication of measurement units used to represent the value in the Quantity in Measurement Unit.

Field.Name: Quantity in Measurement Unit
Field.Description: The Quantity in Measurement Unit, limited to a precision of IEEE 754 Double Standard.

Field.Name: Transaction to be Cleared
Field.Description: Identifies if the firm intends to clear the transaction. ESMA field for derivatives. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: Emission Allowance Type
Field.Description: Emission Allowance Type. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: Venue of Publication
Field.Description: Identification of the regulatory regime under which the transaction was published. The value sent by the source venue is passed on. ECHO = UK APA Regulation, ECEU = EU APA Regulation, or the MIC corresponding to the relevant RM/MTF/OTF.

Field.Name: Market Mechanism
Field.Description: Market mechanism on which the transaction was executed.

Field.Name: Trading Mode
Field.Description: Trading mode in which the transaction was executed.

Field.Name: Transaction Category
Field.Description: Transaction category short code.

Field.Name: Negotiation Indicator
Field.Description: Negotiation indicator short code.

Field.Name: Agency Cross Indicator
Field.Description: Agency cross indicator short code.

Field.Name: Modification Indicator
Field.Description: Modification indicator short code.

Field.Name: Reference Price Indicator
Field.Description: Reference price indicator short code.

Field.Name: Special Dividend Indicator
Field.Description: Special dividend indicator short code.

Field.Name: Off Book Automated Indicator
Field.Description: Off book automated indicator.

Field.Name: Price Formation Indicator
Field.Description: Price formation indicator short code.

Field.Name: Algorithmic Indicator
Field.Description: Algorithmic indicator short code.

Field.Name: Post-Trade Deferral Reason
Field.Description: Post trade deferral reason short code.

Field.Name: Deferral Enrichment Type
Field.Description: Deferral or enrichment type short code.

Field.Name: Duplicative Indicator
Field.Description: Duplicative indicator short code.

Field.Name: Third-country trading venue of execution
Field.Description: Identification of the third-country trading venue where the transaction was executed.

Field.Name: Portfolio Transaction Flag
Field.Description: PORT when the trade is a portfolio trade.

Field.Name: Contingent Transaction Flag
Field.Description: CONT when the trade is a contingent trade.

Field.Name: Missing Price / Price Conditions
Field.Description: Missing Price (ESMA) / Price Conditions (FCA), PNDG or NOAP.

Field.Name: Market Closing Price Flag
Field.Description: CLSE for a benchmark transaction executed at the market closing price.

Field.Name: NT Large in Scale Flag
Field.Description: NTLS for a negotiated trade larger than LIS brought onto a venue.

Field.Name: NT Pre Trade Transparency Flag
Field.Description: NETW for a negotiated trade with a pre trade transparency waiver.

Field.Name: Effective Date of the Contract
Field.Description: Start date of the contract. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: Maturity Date of the Contract
Field.Description: Termination date of the financial instrument's contract. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: Spread
Field.Description: The spread on the floating leg, limited to a precision of IEEE 754 Double Standard. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: Upfront Payment
Field.Description: The upfront payment exchanged as part of CDS transactions, limited to a precision of {DECIMAL-19/18}. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: LEI of Clearing House
Field.Description: Clearing house which the transaction will be cleared through. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: Matched Principal Trade Flag
Field.Description: MTCH when the trade is a matched principal trade.

Field.Name: ESMA Standard Deferral Flags
Field.Description: ESMA standard deferral flag.

Field.Name: Negotiation Trade Flag
Field.Description: NEGO when the trade is a negotiation trade.

Field.Name: ESMA Supplementary Deferral Flags
Field.Description: ESMA supplementary deferral flag.

Field.Name: Trading System
Field.Description: Type of trading system on which the transaction was executed. Blank if not specified in the underlying trade report or Venue of Execution is populated with SINT or XOFF.
